headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a convincing 10-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jake Mangum leading the charge at the plate. Mangum's impressive performance included 4 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The New York Mets also secured a win, taking down the Kansas City Royals 7-3 behind Sean Manaea's 7.0 innings pitched. Juan Soto hit a crucial 21st home run of the season for the Mets.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Tanner Banks, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm strain with the Philadelphia Phillies. Other notable injuries include Brad Lord (Washington Nationals), Owen Caissie (Miami Marlins), John King (Miami Marlins), Tim Herrin (Cleveland Guardians), Ranger Suarez (Boston Red Sox), Connor Prielipp (Minnesota Twins), and Samad Taylor (San Diego Padres).

The New York Mets made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash. The Detroit Tigers also traded right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. Other notable trades include Ryan Degges going from the Philadelphia Phillies to the Cleveland Guardians for cash, and Tom Cosgrove going from the Houston Astros to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings pitched. Tyrone Taylor led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Juan Soto hit a crucial 21st home run of the season for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Yankees Blast Past Rays 12-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory. Ben Rice led the Yankees' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a close game to the Baltimore Orioles, losing 2-3. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Phillies Place Tanner Banks on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Philadelphia Phillies left-handed pitcher Tanner Banks has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm strain.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
